prompt: Challenge C144-CH2: Downstream purification — specifically the ultrafiltration step — runs at only 55% of nominal throughput because the membranes foul with res

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Spiral-wound polyethersulfone ultrafiltration modules show irreversible fouling after 8 h, with a two-step cleaning sequence (0.3 % citric acid, then 0.5 % NaOH) restoring 94 % of clean-water flux.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07419","field":"abstract","quote":"Irreversible fouling after 8 h was quantified at 18 % flux loss; a two-step cleaning sequence (0.3 % citric acid, then 0.5 % NaOH) restored 94 % of clean-water flux"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Edible oil processing employs dead-end and cross-flow filtration with filter-aid characterization, and solid-liquid separation staging is described in industrial practice.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07417","field":"abstract","quote":"dead-end and cross-flow filtration, including compressible cake theory and the role of filter aids"}]}]}
